newsitem.title: USA: Hungarian Teleconstruct forms Internet service.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian Teleconstruct forms Internet service.

text.p: Hungarian Teleconstruct Inc Tuesday said it has acquired three Hungarian Internet Service Providers, EUnet, Internet Hungary and Enet.
Terms of the deals were not disclosed.
The company said it created EuroWeb, its new Internet service, from the merged providers. It will debut in February 1997, and is expected to be profitable in the year.

"Once we are over the expense of merging operations we expect to operate profitably and project overall profitability in 1997," stated R. Jeffrey Bartlett, Director of Operations of Hungarian Teleconstruct.

"... (The) acquisition and merger of (these) three profitable companies will produce the highest standard of Internet service currently offered in Hungary," Chairman Robert Genova said in a statement.
